title: Menu world cup: data/content/worldcup.json
description: Written by a person: the dishes of worldcup.html, by catalog id (data/foods/). The page shuffles them into a bracket; names and flavours come from the catalog. validate_content.py checks what a schema cannot: every id is a catalog dish and the count is a power of two.

basis.description: One plain sentence per language: how the dishes were chosen.
